messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page fired: INC-20260315-09 - Objective: canary /v1/generate 503 spike. Trigger: 5xx rate > 7% over 2m. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-20260315-09

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-20260315-09 created and escalated to primary oncall. Unacknowledged for 30s.

alice_oncall: ack'ing. I'm on it — looking at canary traffic. Which rollout hit prod?

carla_release: That's the canary for release v2.14.3 (edge canary fraction 10%). Started 03/15 09:10 UTC. Rolling artifacts: image redwood/api-gen:v2.14.3

alice_oncall: thanks. quick healthcheck: calling /health on canary host shows 200 for control plane, but generate returns 503s.

alice_oncall: paste logs from proxy:
```
[09:22:03] upstream 503 overloaded: recv timeout
[09:22:08] 503 x 42 in 2m - backend model worker OOM?
[09:22:12] kvcache miss storm for prefix embeddings
```

bob_infra: seeing repeated OOM/killed on canary nodes in metrics. GPU memory cliffs after tokenizer change in 2.14.3.

frank_sre: Confirmed elevated p95 token latency -> backlog -> 503 from streaming proxy. Likely change in tokenizer preproc or batch sizing.

carla_release: rolling back canary to v2.14.2 now. Command: `kubectl -n production set image deploy/api-canary api-container=redwood/api-gen:v2.14.2`

alice_oncall: executing. Reducing canary traffic to 0% to stop customer risk: `routingctl set-weight canary 0`

emma_devex: heads up — customers using streaming may have had partial responses. CS alerted?

dave_support: I'm patching CS notes and triage doc. No high-touch customers on canary region but a handful of API keys saw errors ~09:20-09:24 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: INC-20260315-09 acknowledged by alice_oncall at 09:23:15 UTC. Escalation paused.

bob_infra: kube rollout status shows `deployment "api-canary" successfully rolled back` at 09:24:02 UTC. Pod restarts decreasing.

alice_oncall: routingctl output: canary weight -> 0% confirmed. Traffic diverted to stable pool. 5xx rate on stable baseline normal.

frank_sre: backend metrics trending back to normal. 5xx dropped from 8.2% -> 0.3% over 2m. p95 token latency back to baseline.

carla_release: filing PR to revert tokenizer change and pin quantization flag for next canary. tagging follow-up: REL-2134.

alice_oncall: stamping incident as mitigation complete. Initiating handoff to postmortem owner. Who owns the follow-up?

carla_release: I'll own the rollback PR and canary gating changes. Will coordinate with research for tokenizer experiments.

dave_support: Noting customer impact: transient 503s for ~4m window for a small subset of customers in canary region. No billing impact. Updating support incident.

emma_devex: adding prompt-level evals to the rollout checklist so tokenizer regressions catch earlier.

frank_sre: PD note: resolving paging chain. Also adding suppression rule for this noisy 5xx pattern during canary to avoid autopage storms while we triage — will be conservative.

pagerduty-bot: INC-20260315-09 marked RESOLVED by alice_oncall at 09:27:03 UTC.

alice_oncall: final checks: running smoke tests against canary image v2.14.3 in staging to reproduce. If reproducible, we'll run bisect on tokenizer patch. Otherwise mark as infra flake.

carla_release: PR opened: revert/tokenizer-change REL-2134. Will schedule a safe re-roll once fix validated.

alice_oncall: closing thread. Follow-ups: owner=carla_release, sev=low, impact=partial-canary-customer-errors, timeline=09:20-09:24 UTC. Postmortem doc -> TKT-3456 in 48h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Note: This thread will be archived. Create postmortem when follow-up closes.
